comment.body: @ntnguyen1234 Hi, here is my response: Environment: - Browser: ungoogled-chromium 151.0.7922.173 (Official Build), 64-bit - AdGuard Browser Extension: 5.5.2.8 To reproduce: 1. Delete koreanair.com cookies from your browser. 2. Visit koreanair.com. 3. Navigate to the SkyPass page via the site's navigation menu (highlighted area in the attached screenshot). The issue was reproducible in my environment following the steps above. However, when I just checked again, I found that on the first page load after deleting cookies, the sub-menus under the top navigation (including SkyPass) do not appear at all with the AdGuard extension enabled, making it impossible to reach the page via the menu at that point. Notes on this sub-menu problem: - Reloading the page does NOT fix it. - Toggling the AdGuard extension off and back on DOES fix it (sub-menus reappear). - Accessing the SkyPass page directly via URL does not reproduce the original `-has-dialog` issue — navigating via the menu appears to be a necessary condition — so this sub-menu problem currently blocks verification of the original issue on first load. For reference, I also see the same two symptoms (scroll lock, sub-menu not appearing) on Firefox + uBlock Origin when subscribing to the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS.

comment.body:
> No need to use :has() when the final view is the same.

I see. I didn't understand what you meant by that at the time. How about following suggestion?

```suggestion
nikkei.com##button[title$="で共有する"]
```

Can you narrow down the `button` to

```suggestion
fondee.pl#%#//scriptlet('trusted-click-element', 'div[class^="CookieConsent-module_footer"] > button', 'containsText:Zaakceptuj niezbędne')
```

issue.title: Dangerous site: microcomputer-i.store — tech-support scam impersonating Microsoft (Luxembourg-targeted)
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue
- [x] Verified the domain is not already covered by AdGuard DNS filter or AdGuard's scam/phishing filters

### What type of problem have you encountered?

**Dangerous site** — phishing / tech-support scam impersonating Microsoft.

### Where is the problem encountered?

`https://microcomputer-i.store/`

### Description

The site presents itself as **"Microsoft Luxembourg Support - Microsoft Gare Luxembourg"** and offers 24/7 "support", live chat and a callback form. "Microsoft" appears 48 times on the front page. Microsoft operates no such support office and the site has no affiliation with Microsoft.

This is a tech-support scam: victims are induced to call, then talked into granting remote access and paying for fictitious problems.

The page lists **three different callback numbers in three countries**, which is inconsistent with any legitimate national support desk:

| Number | Country |
|---|---|
| `+352 28 800 321` | Luxembourg — the clickable `tel:` link, used as local bait |
| `+41 245 391 543` | Switzerland |
| `+255 747 624 132` | Tanzania |

### Domain / infrastructure

- Registered **2026-08-12** (1-year term), registrar HOSTINGER operations, UAB
- NS `hyperion.dns-parking.com` / `atlas.dns-parking.com`, MX `mx1/mx2.hostinger.com`
- Fast-flux: **48-second TTL**, rotating across at least five Hostinger ranges — `147.79.116.0/22`, `193.58.105.0/24`, `77.37.50.0/24` (HOSTINGER-HOSTING, FR) and `2.57.91.0/24`, `84.32.84.0/24` (HOSTINGER-CDN, LT)

### Why this is worth adding

At time of reporting the domain appears in **no public blocklist** I could check — including AdGuard DNS filter, AdGuard's scam/phishing filter, HaGeZi (Pro++/Ultimate/TIF/Fake), OISD Big, Phishing Army, PhishTank/OpenPhish, URLhaus, ShadowWhisperer, DurableNapkin and Phishing.Database — and it is **not blocked by AdGuard DNS, Cloudflare Malware (1.1.1.2), Quad9, OpenDNS, CleanBrowsing Security or ControlD**. End users currently get no warning.

The domain is being used against Luxembourg residents specifically, via a local `+352` number.

### Note on the required product/version fields

I do not run an AdGuard product myself — I filter with Pi-hole and encountered this via a report from an AdGuard user. I therefore cannot give a meaningful product version, and did not want to invent one. Reporting here because the domain belongs in the DNS/scam filters regardless of which client blocks it. Happy to move this to the web reporting tool if that is preferred.

issue.title: Dangerous site: microcomputer-i.store — tech-support scam impersonating Microsoft (Luxembourg-targeted)

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue
- [x] Verified the domain is not already covered by AdGuard DNS filter or AdGuard's scam/phishing filters

### What type of problem have you encountered?

**Dangerous site** — phishing / tech-support scam impersonating Microsoft.

### Where is the problem encountered?

`https://microcomputer-i.store/`

### Description

The site presents itself as **"Microsoft Luxembourg Support - Microsoft Gare Luxembourg"** and offers 24/7 "support", live chat and a callback form. "Microsoft" appears 48 times on the front page. Microsoft operates no such support office and the site has no affiliation with Microsoft.

This is a tech-support scam: victims are induced to call, then talked into granting remote access and paying for fictitious problems.

The page lists **three different callback numbers in three countries**, which is inconsistent with any legitimate national support desk:

| Number | Country |
|---|---|
| `+352 28 800 321` | Luxembourg — the clickable `tel:` link, used as local bait |
| `+41 245 391 543` | Switzerland |
| `+255 747 624 132` | Tanzania |

### Domain / infrastructure

- Registered **2026-08-12** (1-year term), registrar HOSTINGER operations, UAB
- NS `hyperion.dns-parking.com` / `atlas.dns-parking.com`, MX `mx1/mx2.hostinger.com`
- Fast-flux: **48-second TTL**, rotating across at least five Hostinger ranges — `147.79.116.0/22`, `193.58.105.0/24`, `77.37.50.0/24` (HOSTINGER-HOSTING, FR) and `2.57.91.0/24`, `84.32.84.0/24` (HOSTINGER-CDN, LT)

### Why this is worth adding

At time of reporting the domain appears in **no public blocklist** I could check — including AdGuard DNS filter, AdGuard's scam/phishing filter, HaGeZi (Pro++/Ultimate/TIF/Fake), OISD Big, Phishing Army, PhishTank/OpenPhish, URLhaus, ShadowWhisperer, DurableNapkin and Phishing.Database — and it is **not blocked by AdGuard DNS, Cloudflare Malware (1.1.1.2), Quad9, OpenDNS, CleanBrowsing Security or ControlD**. End users currently get no warning.

The domain is being used against Luxembourg residents specifically, via a local `+352` number.

### Note on the required product/version fields

I do not run an AdGuard product myself — I filter with Pi-hole and encountered this via a report from an AdGuard user. I therefore cannot give a meaningful product version, and did not want to invent one. Reporting here because the domain belongs in the DNS/scam filters regardless of which client blocks it. Happy to move this to the web reporting tool if that is preferred.

issue.title: www.youtube.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

It functions as a tracker/gateway, capturing user data and navigation journeys before forwarding them to the final commercial betting site.Please consider adding this domain to the tracking and/or adware filters (such as the AdGuard Tracking Protection filter) to protect users from unwanted redirection and background tracking.Thank you for your hard work and for keeping the web clean. ### Screenshots

issue.title: www.youtube.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check);

issue.title: google.com — URL Tracking filter removing biw/bih breaks Google Lens and AI Mode (ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS), reproduction for closed PR #230570
issue.body:
### Problem

The URL Tracking filter (ID 17) strips `biw` and `bih` from Google Search URLs:

```adblock
||google.*/search$removeparam=biw
||google.*/search$removeparam=bih
```

Google re-adds them with a 302, the filter strips them again, and Chrome gives up with `ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS`. The result is that Google Lens and Google AI Mode (`udm=50`) never load.

This was previously reported in #230074 and fixed by PR #230570, which was closed on 2026-05-05 because the maintainer could not reproduce it. This report is an independent reproduction with the redirect loop captured, plus an explanation of why it does not always reproduce.

### Affected URLs

```
https://www.google.com/search?udm=50&ccb=1&aep=117&cs=1&gsc=2&hl=en-US&biw=440&bih=974
https://www.google.com/search?q=&ie=UTF-8&lns_fp=1&lns_mode=un&plla=<redacted>&lns_surface=42&ccb=1&cs=1&gsc=2&hl=en-US&biw=440&bih=974
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable the AdGuard URL Tracking filter (in AdGuard for Mac this is gated behind Stealth Mode → "Strip tracking parameters from URLs").
2. Open any page in Chrome. Reproduced on `https://x.com/home`.
3. Click "Search with Google Lens" in the Chrome toolbar.

The Lens side panel shows Chrome's error page:

> This page isn't working — www.google.com redirected you too many times.
> ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS

### Evidence of the loop

Chrome DevTools attached to the Lens side panel logs the following about 13 times, all from `extensions::webViewEvents:268`. The URLs alternate between having and not having `biw` / `bih`, which is the strip-and-re-add loop:

```
<webview>: The load has aborted with error -310: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS. url:
https://www.google.com/search?udm=50&ccb=1&aep=117&cs=1&gsc=2&hl=en-US&biw=440&bih=974

<webview>: The load has aborted with error -310: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS. url:
https://www.google.com/search?udm=50&ccb=1&aep=117&cs=1&gsc=2&hl=en-US

<webview>: The load has aborted with error -310: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS. url:
https://www.google.com/search?udm=50&ccb=1&aep=117&cs=1&gsc=2&hl=en-US&biw=440&bih=974

<webview>: The load has aborted with error -310: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS. url:
https://www.google.com/search?udm=50&ccb=1&aep=117&cs=1&gsc=2&hl=en-US

<webview>: The load has aborted with error -3: ERR_ABORTED. url:
https://support.google.com/chrome?p=rl_error&hl=en-US
```

The Network panel stays empty, since nothing survives the chain.

### Why #230570 may not have reproduced

The Lens side panel is a narrow `<webview>`, so `biw=440`. In a normal full-width tab Google appears to tolerate the missing parameters, but at side-panel width it insists on them and redirects. Testing in a full-size window is likely to show no problem, which matches "I can't reproduce" on the earlier PR.

### Bisection

Turning off the URL Tracking filter's parameter stripping fixes it immediately, with everything else unchanged. Confirmed not responsible: AdGuard Base (ID 2), Tracking Protection (ID 3), Cookie Notices (ID 18), Online Malicious URL Blocklist (ID 208), Phishing URL Blocklist (ID 255), and the other Stealth Mode options (hide search queries, block trackers, WebRTC, push, anti-DPI).

Also ruled out before finding the cause: Google cookies were cleared, third-party cookie settings changed, VPN exit pinned to a single country, Chrome Secure DNS disabled, and all Chrome extensions disabled. None of these made a difference.

### Suggested fix

Either drop the two rules as PR #230570 proposed, or keep them but exclude the surfaces that need the parameters, for example when the request carries `udm=50`, `gsc=2`, or `lns_surface=`.

`biw` and `bih` are viewport dimensions used for layout, not tracking identifiers.

### Environment

- AdGuard for Mac 2.19.0.2258 release (CL-1.20.101, DNS-2.7.6)
- URL Tracking filter (ID 17) version 2.0.14.9
- Google Chrome 152.0.7977.76, arm64
- macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), Apple Silicon
